Dunsky Energy + Climate Advisors (2024). Heat pumps pay off: Unlocking lower-cost heating and cooling in Canada - Technical Memo (updated February 2024), prepared for the Canadian Climate Institute.

Technical memo for the CCI report: Dunsky HEAT model of residential space heating in five cities (building archetypes and vintages, heating loads per m2), heat pump sizing and seasonal COP (cold-climate ASHP about 2.8; system 2.5-3.3), incentives and lifetime costs per household. Residential buildings only; no industrial equipment.
